message:
Running command: bash -lc 'python3 - <<"PY"
from pathlib import Path
# doc offsets in main entity (not counting fuzzer prefix). push chunks doc only in fuzzXml push parser.
for off in range(120,132):
    doc=b" "*off+b"<a/>"
    p=f"/tmp/push_{off}.fuzz"
    Path(p).write_bytes(b"\0\0\0\0\0\0\0\0doc.xml\\\n"+doc+b"\\\n")
PY
for f in /tmp/push_*.fuzz; do ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=0 /tmp/xml_fuzz_run $f >/tmp/out 2>&1; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || grep -q "ERROR: AddressSanitizer" /tmp/out; then echo ===$f rc=$rc===; head -100 /tmp/out; fi; done'
